findings.description: Micaela Salgado had a son, Guillermo Salgado, baptized 20 October 1889 in San Miguel, Tegucigalpa, Francisco Morazán — no father is named in the record, consistent with the tree not recording a spouse for Micaela — in addition to her two daughters already in the tree (Raimunda b. 1874, Maria Norberta b. 1884).

target_person.name: Guillermo Salgado
target_person.birth: baptized 20 October 1889, San Miguel, Tegucigalpa, Francisco Morazán, Honduras
